profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Tech Lead at Google
profile.summary:
RECRUITERS: I am NOT looking to change jobs at this time. Cold calls will be ignored.

Experienced and passionate manager, teacher, and mentor. Self-motivated senior software engineer with deep knowledge of distributed systems, multithreaded server design, and networking. Thorough command of theoretical computer science and outstanding software engineering skills including design, testing, tuning, and productionization. Strong interpersonal skills and excellent writing ability.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Feb 2013-Nov 2018, Sept 2021-Present - Networking Load Balancing Team
Sept 2021-Present - Tech Lead
May 2015-Present - Senior Software Engineer

Oct 2019-Sept 2021 - Cloud Networking Team
Dec 2016-Nov 2018, Oct 2019-Sept 2021 - Tech Lead / Manager
Nov 2018-Oct 2019 - Colossus File System Team
Feb 2013-May 2015 - Software Engineer III

Tech Lead for the RDU Network Load Balancing team. Building a cohesive, empowered team and helping my team members grow and succeed.

Designed, wrote, and maintained complex distributed systems that form integral pieces of Google's networking infrastructure. Designed, built, and publicly launched Cloud Networking products.

Conducted dozens of engineering interviews and served on hiring committees and promo committees. Received awards for dedication to unbiased HC reviews.

positions.title: Adjunct Assistant Professor of Computer Science
positions.description: Taught a Master's level class on Databases.

positions.title: Summer of Code Open Source Internship (Cairo Graphics)
